pairs: Egressus est post hæc vir de domo Levi:
After these things, a man from the house of Levi went out,
and he took a wife from his own stock.
And seeing him to be handsome,
she hid him for three months.
And when she was no longer able to hide him,
she took a small basket woven of bulrushes,
et linivit eam bitumine ac pice:
and she smeared it with pitch as well as tar.
And she placed the little infant inside,
et exposuit eum in carecto ripæ fluminis,
and she laid him in the sedges by the bank of the river.
His sister was standing at a distance
and was wondering what would happen.
Ecce autem descendebat filia Pharaonis ut lavaretur in flumine:
Then, behold, the daughter of Pharaoh descended to wash in the river.
et puellæ ejus gradiebantur per crepidinem alvei. Quæ cum vidisset fiscellam in papyrione,
And her maids walked along the edge of the cove. And when she had seen the small basket among the papyruses,
misit unam e famulabus suis: et allatam
she sent one of her servants for it. And when it was brought,
and realizing that within it was a little one crying,
“This is one of the infants of the Hebrews.”
And the sister of the boy said to her:
I will go and call to you a Hebrew woman,
who will be able nurse the infant.”
Perrexit puella et vocavit matrem suam.
The maid went directly and called her mother.
Ad quam locuta filia Pharaonis: Accipe,
And the daughter of Pharaoh said to her:
ait, puerum istum, et nutri mihi:
“Take this boy and nurse him for me.
ego dabo tibi mercedem tuam. Suscepit mulier,
I will give you your wages.” The woman took and nursed the boy.
she delivered him to the daughter of Pharaoh.
Quem illa adoptavit in locum filii,
And she adopted him in place of a son,
and she called his name Moses,
“Because I took him from the water.”
In diebus illis postquam creverat Moyses,
In those days, after Moses had grown up,
he went out to his brothers.
viditque afflictionem eorum, et virum ægyptium percutientem quemdam de Hebræis fratribus suis.
And he saw their affliction and an Egyptian man striking a certain one of the Hebrews, his brothers.
And when he had looked around this way and that,
and had seen no one nearby,
he struck down the Egyptian and hid him in the sand.
Et egressus die altero conspexit duos Hebræos rixantes:
And going out the next day, he spotted two Hebrews quarrelling violently.
And he said to him who was causing the injury,
Quis te constituit principem et judicem super nos?
“Who appointed you as leader and judge over us?
Do you want to kill me,
just as yesterday you killed the Egyptian?”
Quomodo palam factum est verbum istud?
and he sought to kill Moses.
he stayed in the land of Midian,
and he sat down next to a well.
Erant autem sacerdoti Madian septem filiæ, quæ venerunt ad hauriendam aquam:
Now there was a priest of Midian with seven daughters, who came to draw water.
et impletis canalibus adaquare cupiebant greges patris sui.
And having filled the troughs, they desired to water their father’s flocks.
Quæ cum revertissent ad Raguel patrem suum,
And when they had returned to their father, Reuel,
“Why have you arrived sooner than usual?”
Vir ægyptius liberavit nos de manu pastorum:
“A man of Egypt freed us from the hands of the shepherds.
he also drew water with us and gave the sheep to drink.”
Why have you dismissed the man?
so that he may eat bread.”
Juravit ergo Moyses quod habitaret cum eo.
Therefore, Moses swore that he would live with him.
And he accepted his daughter Zipporah as a wife.
And she bore a son to him,
“I have been a newcomer in a foreign land.”
Deus enim patris mei adjutor meus eripuit me de manu Pharaonis.
“For the God of my father, my helper, has rescued me from the hand of Pharaoh.”
Post multum vero tempore mortuus est rex Ægypti:
In truth, after a long time, the king of Egypt was dead.
And the sons of Israel, groaning,
cried out because of the works.
ascenditque clamor eorum ad Deum ab operibus.
And their cry ascended to God from the works.
ac recordatus est fœderis quod pepigit cum Abraham,
and he also remembered the covenant which he formed with Abraham,
And the Lord looked with favor on the sons of Israel,
